summary: Rocket Companies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 1.01 reporting the closing of a private offering of $900M 6.125% senior notes due 2031 and $600M 6.500% senior notes due 2034. The proceeds will be used to repay existing Rocket Mortgage notes due 2026 and 2028, plus other indebtedness. The notes are senior unsecured and guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt via a note offering; it is not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
